## ScanMaster 1.1.0

This release improves capture, page editing, and document navigation.

### Highlights

- Scan whiteboards, books, documents, ID cards, and business cards with category-specific framing. Book mode splits a captured spread into two pages.
- Adjust the capture area and use device orientation to frame scans.
- Crop pages interactively, apply automatic margins, rotate pages, and adjust brightness and contrast.
- Explore updated document viewer, home, folder, and search screens.

### Install

Download the `ScanMaster-*.apk` attached below to install or update ScanMaster on your Android device.
